body.title: Tests: decline diff-only path, assembler fallback, runner opts, enforce gate
body.summary: Finalize the s10 test suite, node:test via npx tsx --test. In src/mcp/code-review-step/__tests__/handler.test.ts: extend makeDeps with an injectable assembleDiffGrounding + a runReview spy that records opts; REPLACE the s9 abort->review-declined assertion (~handler.test.ts:312) with the diff-only expectation. In src/workflow/code-review/__tests__: add the enforce-gate degraded-warn test; confirm the assembler + runner unit tests (from t2/t3/t5) and the gated integration test all pass. Run the code-review + mcp suites green.
acceptanceChecks: handler.test.ts abort->review-declined assertion is replaced by the diff-only expectation and the decline/degraded/diff-unavailable/ac6 tests pass
the assembler unit tests (working-tree, HEAD^ fallback, binary, both-empty, truncated-diff bounded grounding, read-only) + the gated real-git integration test pass
the runner groundingMode-stamp + warn-cap unit tests and the degraded-warn enforce-gate test pass
the full code-review + mcp suites run green

tests.name: gate: the codeReview.enforce gate over a groundingMode:'degraded' record with verdict 'warn' withholds completion (requires an override), exactly as any non-pass verdict does
handler: the abort path no longer returns 'review-declined' (the s9 assertion is replaced by the diff-only expectation)
